description: Preview the count for one requested population; this does not create a saved audience. With segment_id, the current segment count snapshot is updated. Returns count and optional group_by breakdown. Use filters (AND conditions) or filter_groups (advanced compound filters), segment_id (resolve filters from a saved segment), audience_id (resolve from a saved audience), or segment_ids+set_logic (compose multiple segments, optionally with excluded_segment_ids for an ad-hoc "A minus B" preview). All inputs are mutually exclusive — providing more than one is rejected with AMBIGUOUS_INPUT. Requires 'discovery' scope.

audience_id.description: Saved audience ID — resolve its composition via segment memberships (any subtype mix)

excluded_segment_ids.description: Ad-hoc "A minus B" preview — segments to subtract from the segment_ids composition, without persisting an audience

combinator.description: Join to the preceding included group; ignored for the first group. AND binds before OR. Exclusion groups always subtract.

filters.description: All conditions in this group must match

field.description: field_name from get_field_catalog; ZIP5 also accepts zip, zip_code or postal_code. Use published operators and enum_values

text_comparison.description: STRING =, !=, IN, NOT IN, LIKE and ARRAY<STRING> ARRAY_CONTAINS, ARRAY_CONTAINS_ANY. Default exact. case_insensitive applies Unicode case folding to stored text and the supplied value; use when capitalization is incidental.

trim_whitespace.description: Supported STRING or ARRAY<STRING> comparisons only. Trim leading/trailing whitespace on both sides; default false.

value.description: Scalar for comparisons; array for IN/NOT IN; ARRAY_CONTAINS_ANY matches any listed value; [lower, upper] inclusive for BETWEEN; LIKE uses % for any sequence and _ for one character; omit for IS NULL/IS NOT NULL. Use enum_values codes, not display labels

id.description: Caller-chosen group ID, for example geography; prefix _exclude:: to subtract this group

group_by.description: Field with groupable=true in get_field_catalog; mutually exclusive with automatic breakdowns

include_breakdowns.description: When true, also return demographic/geographic breakdowns (slower). Default false.

set_logic.description: How to combine segment_ids (required when segment_ids is provided)

count_state.description: Unknown means no count; available does not guarantee freshness. Recount for a current value.

guidance.description: Interpretation or recovery guidance for this result

next_actions.description: Suggested next calls using returned IDs and available scopes. Not executed and not user consent.

page_count.description: Number of objects on this page, not the organization total

population_input.description: Population input used for the preview; IDs refer to their current saved definitions
